changes.title: Texas' 15th Congressional District provides clues to state's Latino vote
changes.summary: The 15th Congressional District runs from the east of San Antonio all the way down into the Rio Grande Valley. This majority-Latino district provides a window into the Latino vote in Texas.

changes.title: Protester grabbed by audience member at Texas Trump rally
changes.summary: A man who was protesting President Trump at a rally in San Antonio was briefly grabbed by another person in the audience, who was then pulled off the protester by others in the crowd.

changes.title: Trump says he thinks he's "helping the Republican Party with the rallies" ahead of midterms
changes.summary: President Trump spoke with reporters outside the White House on Wednesday before leaving for an event in San Antonio, Texas. Mr. Trump discussed the Iran war, the midterm elections and more.
